W: Scroll racks, floor to ceiling. The labels are in a script you almost remember.
T: Scrolls, thousands of them, tied with faded ribbon.
B: Scrolls, thousands of them, tied with faded ribbon.
M: A high window. Somewhere up there is the sky.
c: A candle that never seems to burn down.
p: A pile of scrolls waiting to be shelved. Nobody has got round to it in a while.
D: The Keeper's desk. A ledger lies open, every line in the same careful hand.
O: Your cocoon. The silk is split where you pushed your way out.
_: Cold stone. The rest of the world is out there somewhere.
=: The great door. It won't budge. Not yet.

objects.name: The Keeper
lines: Ah, you're on your feet. I'm so glad to finally see you again.
Oh dear. Where do I begin?

answer: You're in a pocket dimension. I've been keeping you company for the past five hundred years.
Let's just say I'm an old friend.
I know more than I'm saying. I won't pretend I don't.
But who you were is yours to find. I think you'd rather remember it than be told.

questions.ask: What am I supposed to do now?
answer: Well, you could stay here, if you'd like. We could play cards.
Outside of this Archive is the Other World.
You don't have the same power you once had. You'll have to grow stronger, a little each day.
Your actions in the real world affect your strength in this one.
In time, higher levels will grant you abilities you once had.
Level up once, any way you like, and the great door will open. Once you're out there, you can do whatever you'd like.

objects.name: Brannoc
lines: You're up! Good, good. I was guarding you. From over here. Tactically.

objects.name: Ysolde
lines: Awake at last. Five hundred years of lodging, and not a coin paid. I'm joking. Mostly.

objects.name: Quill
lines: Oh! You're awake! Do you know how many books are in here? I do. Roughly. Give or take a shelf.

objects.name: Wren
lines: Welcome back. Take it slowly. The first steps are always the strangest.

objects.name: Pip
lines: There you are! I wrote you a welcome song. It's mostly about sleeping. Very restful chorus.

objects.name: Tamsin
lines: Mind that shelf. It wobbles. I'll fix it. Later.

objects.name: Moss
lines: Tuft noticed you before I did. He notices everything.
